title: Duration of the Pet Addendum — End at Move-Out and In-Community Transfers
content:
**Clause E1.** Every Pet Addendum ends on the lease's move-out date. The addendum ends because possession of the apartment home ended, and its end date is the lease's move-out date.

**Clause E2.** A Pet Addendum carries over on an in-community transfer when its addendum type provides that the addendum carries over on an in-community transfer.

### Clauses E1 and E2 in brief

| Event on the lease | Effect on the Pet Addendum |
|---|---|
| Possession of the apartment home ends at move-out | The addendum ends; its end date is the lease's move-out date |
| The household transfers to another apartment home in the same community, under an addendum type that carries over | The addendum carries over |

### Questions the clauses answer

**Does the addendum stay in force after the household moves out?** No. Clause E1 ends every Pet Addendum on the lease's move-out date, whatever the addendum type.

**Which date is the end date when the addendum ends at move-out?** The lease's move-out date.

**Does an in-community transfer require a new Pet Addendum for the animal?** Where the addendum type carries over on an in-community transfer, the existing addendum carries over.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A lease with a hypothetical move-out date of 31 August has an active Pet Addendum for a cat. The addendum ends with an end date of 31 August.
